summary.text: Frank Carr is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said his background is in federal risk management and cybersecurity.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Frank Carr said his background is in federal risk management and cybersecurity and that he audits complex systems for a living.

He listed his key messages as better management of state spending so that public schools and special education programs are fully funded, independent redistricting, and protecting constitutional rights by avoiding laws he described as unconstitutional.
Carr named public education, transparency and digital privacy as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
